test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 16 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: At what rate of interest per annum will a sum of ₹15,625 amount to ₹19,683 in 1 year and 6 months, if the interest is compounded half-yearly?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For **compounded half-yearly**, time **1 year 6 months** = **3** half-year cycles.

Ratio of **Amount** to **Principal** for 3 cycles = 19,683 ÷ 15,625 = (27/25)³.

Rate per half-year = [(27 − 25) / 25] × 100 = 8%.

Annual **Rate of Interest** = 8% × 2 = 16%.

**∴ The correct answer is 16%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** **Principal (P)** = ₹15,625, **Amount (A)** = ₹19,683, **Time (T)** = 1.5 years.

**Formula Used:** A = P(1 + r/100)ⁿ, where **r** is the rate per period and **n** is the number of periods.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8935df6315d1d664b3c0502a66a87c7bdeea00a426d6af4bf80220186a32586d.png] 

⇒ Total periods (n) = 1.5 years × 2 = 3 periods.

⇒ 19,683 = 15,625 × (1 + r/100)³

⇒ 19,683 / 15,625 = (1 + r/100)³

⇒ (27/25)³ = (1 + r/100)³

⇒ 1 + r/100 = 27/25

⇒ r/100 = 27/25 − 1 = 2/25

⇒ r = (2/25) × 100 = 8% per half-year.

⇒ Annual Rate = 8% × 2 = 16%.

**∴ The correct answer is 16%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Half-Yearly Compounding

When interest is **compounded half-yearly**, the annual rate is halved (R/2) and the time is doubled (2 × T).

Quarterly Compounding

When interest is **compounded quarterly**, the annual rate is divided by 4 (R/4) and the time is multiplied by 4 (4 × T).

Effective Rate of Interest

It is the actual annual interest rate when compounding occurs more than once a year, calculated as [(1 + r/n)ⁿ − 1] × 100.
